automations.title: Automations
automations.description: Every automation is a real job (name carries the automation: prefix): the switch creates or suspends the schedule itself; unfold a row for trigger history and manual triggers.
automations.createHint: Creates an underlying job (the automation: prefix is added automatically) and wires it into the real scheduler.
automations.deleteHint: Delete "{name}"? The underlying job is removed too — this cannot be undone.
automations.toggleNote: The switch acts on the job directly: ON = create/resume the schedule; OFF = rebuild the job with an enabled:false marker. State is always re-derived from GET /jobs; failed toggles roll back and raise a notification.

state.empty: No automations yet — create one with "New automation".

history.title: Trigger history
history.filteredEmpty: No triggers of this kind yet

form.name: Name
form.scheduleHint: A cron expression (5 fields) or intervalMs in milliseconds (>= 1000).

preview.title: Next {count} runs
preview.noRuns: No upcoming runs found — the expression may never match (e.g. Feb 30).

softIssues.title: Review these warnings
softIssues.hint: The schedule passed validation, but note the following. You can still save.
softIssues.chattyInterval: Fires more than once a minute (every {seconds} s) — noisy unless intentional.
softIssues.domDowBoth: Both day-of-month and day-of-week are restricted: standard cron ORs them, so the job may fire more often than you expect.

errors.nameTooLong: Name is too long (120 chars max including the automation: prefix)
errors.intervalTooShort: intervalMs must be an integer of at least 1000
errors.cronFields: A cron expression needs exactly 5 fields (minute hour dom month dow)

notify.restoreFailed: Rebuild of "{name}" failed and the restore did not complete

automations.search.label: Search automations
automations.slots.hint: Slots come from the underlying job's PendingSlot; times are server-side schedule/update times
automations.history.hint: Recent triggers, filterable by kind — trigger one manually from any row
